paragraphs.text: Sakiko (SAH-kee-koh) Mother of Summer was an Orochi Shaman from Kamigawa who was active during the Kami War .

Sakiko wore a pink kimono and had long black hair tied with a clip. She wielded a blooming snake staff wafting green magic and held a fan in another hand. Her heart beat with the rhythm of the forest. Sakiko was an orochi matron who mastered the art of drawing green mana from her enemies’ holdings.
